name: decorator-metadata
description: 데코레이터 메타데이터(design:type, reflect-metadata)와 번들 결과를 실제로 확인하는 예제

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.json --emitDecoratorMetadata false --outDir out-nometa && tsc -p tsconfig.json --importHelpers --outDir out-helpers
scripts.reflect: node out/02-reflect/without-reflect.js && node out/02-reflect/with-reflect.js && node out/02-reflect/wrong-order.js && node out/02-reflect/inherit.js
scripts.types:nonstrict: tsc -p tsconfig.json --strictNullChecks false --outDir out-nonstrict && node out-nonstrict/03-types/types.js
scripts.target: node out/05-target/static-member.js && node out/05-target/by-name.js && node out/05-target/by-object.js
scripts.mangle: node scripts/mangle.mjs && node dist/mangle/by-name.min.js && node out/07-mangle/app-unminified.js && node out/07-mangle/app.js && node out/08-object-key/app.js
scripts.vite:types: vite build --config vite.types.config.mjs --logLevel warn && node dist/vite-types/types.js
scripts.standard: tsc -p standard/tsconfig.json && node standard/out/standard.js && node standard/out/inherit-naive.js
